edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC5 Each business rule of section 8 holds on the build (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given every rule BR1 to BR9 of section 8 has a test case in section 16
    When the build runs those test cases
    Then every rule holds and the build fails when a rule does not hold

  Scenario: AC6 An error answer of the match operation carries its status code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the request carries no valid credential or the deviationId names no deviation
    When the match operation is called
    Then the caller gets 401 for no valid credential or 404 for no deviation, and nothing is written
    And a role without the case record right gets 403 as AC3 gives

  Scenario: AC7 A repeat of the same match request is answered from the record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the same deviation and complaint references are sent twice
    When the match operation is called twice
    Then one record is written, one answer is sent and the repeat answers the record that exists

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed contract that does not answer in time is retried and times out (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given rwb-source-data does not answer inside 2 s
    When the recordComplaintMatch activity runs
    Then the activity retries on the workflow's own schedule and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves nothing written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given rwb-decision answers with a failure or its breaker is open
    When the match operation is called
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the deviation X1 is at state DEV_RESOLVED
    When the match operation is called
    Then the request is refused as X3 gives, nothing is written and the deviation stays at DEV_RESOLVED
